description: Semantic multi-model crew routing: stable role names on the left, current concrete provider/model assignments on the right. Refresh assignments with scripts/model-router-refresh; pin a role (pinned=true) to protect a manual assignment from refresh.

fallback.reason: High-reliability escalation when Surplus routing fails: the assigned model disappears from the live catalog, its alternates are unhealthy, or the Surplus API is unreachable and a fresh task cannot wait for recovery.
fallback.escalation: role model -> role alternates (live-verified) -> this codex fallback -> hold the task for the operator
fallback.note: The codex CLI is not installed on the acceptance host, so the fallback is documented and preserved here but was not smoke-tested in this environment.

pricingNotes.unit: USD per million tokens, converted from Surplus /v1/models per-token decimals by the pi surplus provider extension.
limitations: Values are catalog-declared list prices at snapshot time, not invoice-verified amounts.
Marketplace seller discounts or surcharges may change the billed price without changing the catalog entry.
The active label reflects healthy sellers at catalog refresh time and can change between refreshes.

FRONTIER_PLANNER.reason: Frontier-class planning and decomposition with a 1M-token context and reasoning; moderate list price keeps planning runs affordable.

CODER.reason: Strong tool-using coding model with a 1M-token context and reasoning at a mid-tier price; the same model has been driving a full agentic coding session locally.

CHEAP_WORKER.reason: Cheapest smoke-verified tool-capable model with reasoning and a 1M-token context; suited to mechanical, well-scoped edits.

SCOUT.reason: Very cheap reasoning model with tool support and a 1M-token context for investigation and evidence gathering.

CRITIC.reason: Independent review from a different model family and context than the implementation roles; reasoning plus tool support for running tests, at a price that suits long reviews.

sources: pi --list-models surplus (pi dynamic provider registry, backed by the live Surplus /v1/models and /api/markets fetch)
catalog.note: All five assigned models and all six alternates passed an exact-string inference test and a real bash tool-call round trip on 2026-09-03; see docs/verification/multi-model-crew.md.
